templates.name: Blank
templates.tagline: The editor's own template: a title slide and a few layouts, ready to fill.

templates.name: Folio
templates.tagline: Editorial spreads on ivory paper: Fraunces headlines with italic emphasis, hairline rules, oxblood numerals.

templates.name: Boardroom
templates.tagline: Business deck in deep navy and white with one amber accent: KPI tiles, a CSS bar chart, a comparison table.

templates.name: Terrarium
templates.tagline: Dark botanical: forest green, sage and blush, Cormorant Garamond headlines, drawn rings and an arched picture plate.

templates.name: Console
templates.tagline: Developer deck in an IDE dark theme: JetBrains Mono, window chrome, syntax-coloured code, a diff, a status bar.

templates.name: Sorbet
templates.tagline: Playful peach, mint and lavender on cream: Fredoka headlines, big soft blobs, pill chips, cards with hard pastel shadows.

templates.name: Blueprint
templates.tagline: Engineering sheets on cyanotype blue: white line grid, Archivo capitals, Space Mono labels, a title block on every sheet.

templates.name: Minimal
templates.tagline: White space and one quiet grotesque at light weights: black on off-white, hairlines, nothing else.

templates.name: Bold
templates.tagline: Enormous condensed capitals in black, warm white and one hot red; slides that are mostly one word.

templates.name: Clean Dark
templates.tagline: Product-keynote look on charcoal: soft bordered panels, one ice-blue accent, quiet glows.

templates.name: Swiss
templates.tagline: International Typographic Style: a visible twelve-column grid, flush-left grotesque, black, white and red.

templates.name: Academic
templates.tagline: A conference talk on white: Source Serif and Source Sans, navy accent, numbered figures and tables, an equation, references.

templates.name: Pitch
templates.tagline: The startup deck structure on warm neutrals with one coral accent: problem, solution, market circles, traction chart, team, the ask.

templates.name: Workshop
templates.tagline: Teaching slides in Rubik with room to draw on: timed exercises, a discussion question, group roles, a quiz, a recap.

templates.name: Portfolio
templates.tagline: Photo-led slides on near-black with almost no chrome: full-bleed plates with a caption bar, a grid, before and after, a triptych.

templates.name: Report
templates.tagline: A reading-first data deck in IBM Plex: KPI rows, CSS bar and stacked charts with annotations, dense tables, status pills.

templates.name: Retro
templates.tagline: A seventies poster: mustard, rust, teal and cream, arches and discs, sunburst stripes, Bricolage Grotesque headlines.

templates.name: Notebook
templates.tagline: Paper and ink: a ruled page with a red margin, Caveat handwriting, hand-drawn underlines and circles, sticky notes, taped pictures.

templates.name: Deco
templates.tagline: Art deco luxury: near-black with gold hairlines, stepped frames, a sunburst fan, Cinzel capitals, Cormorant body.

templates.name: Brutalist
templates.tagline: The raw-web look: 3px borders on everything, black offset shadows, one acid accent, mono labels, marquee bands.

templates.name: Broadsheet
templates.tagline: A newspaper: masthead and dateline, Playfair Display headlines, justified serif columns with drop caps, pull quotes, listings.

templates.name: Aurora
templates.tagline: The launch keynote: a dark base with one big soft gradient wash per slide, glass panels, Outfit headlines.

templates.name: Sunset
templates.tagline: Warm and earthy: terracotta, sand, olive and clay, a low sun and hills, a soft serif for headlines.

templates.name: Nordic
templates.tagline: Scandinavian light: linen and pale wood, muted sage, clay and fjord blue, generous space, Manrope at light weights.

templates.name: Neon
templates.tagline: Sleek cyber dark: magenta and cyan glows on near-black, a perspective grid, outlined panels, mono labels.

templates.name: Comic
templates.tagline: A storyboard: panels with thick borders, speech bubbles, halftone dots, action bursts, Bangers headlines.

templates.name: Tomorrow
templates.tagline: A creative resume: clusters of isometric cubes and floating triangles in teal, slate and orange on light grey, Oswald capitals over a Lora body.

templates.name: Sakura Chroma
templates.tagline: Vintage Japanese cassette-package aesthetic: cream paper, diagonal rainbow ribbons, condensed bold type.

templates.name: Neo-Grid Bold
templates.tagline: Twelve-column card grid on grey with neon-yellow accents, black ink panels and mono tags.

templates.name: BlockFrame
templates.tagline: Neobrutalist deck with pastel-neon colour blocks, chunky black borders and hard shadows.

templates.name: Studio
templates.tagline: Black canvas with electric-yellow type; high-voltage design studio aesthetic.

templates.name: 8-Bit Orbit
templates.tagline: Pixel-art neon arcade aesthetic on a deep navy void: scanlines, starfields, CRT glow.
